children: US vaping technology firm's fiscal Q4 revenue rose 33% yr/yr; full-year revenue fell 25%
Gross margin declined to 12.8% for the year, impacted by inventory impairments and product mix
Company improved adjusted EBITDA loss and reduced operating cash burn by $6.8 mln yr/yr
Company says timing of achieving cash-flow positive is now less certain due to Malaysia investments
Ispire expects fiscal 2027 to be a transformational year with new product launches and contracts
Company sees Malaysia manufacturing and Vapor ODM as near-term growth drivers
RESTRUCTURING AND INVESTMENTS - Co said Q4 revenue growth reflects turnaround efforts and investments made over the past year
MALAYSIA MANUFACTURING - Fully operational Malaysia facility positioned to expand customer base and generate new revenue opportunities, per President Steven Przybyla
INVENTORY IMPAIRMENTS - Gross margin was impacted by inventory impairments in Q4
The current average analyst rating on the shares is "strong buy" and the breakdown of recommendations is 2 "strong buy" or "buy", no "hold" and no "sell" or "strong sell"
The average consensus recommendation for the tobacco peer group is "buy."
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for Ispire Technology Inc is $5.00, about 247.2% above its September 15 closing price of $1.44
